transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Um, I guess I came in because I've just been having these really heavy feelings lately. I keep feeling like I’ve completely let my family down by taking on this new mortgage. It just really weighs on me. And it happens at work, too. I wait tables, and whenever I make even a small mistake, it just feels like proof that I’m useless... like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me. I just can't seem to shake it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um, I'd say it's been about a year and two months. That's how long these periods of feeling really down and guilty have been going on.
During this year and two months, have there been any periods of several weeks or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self, or has this low mood been present almost every day?

Um, well, there haven't really been any long stretches where I felt totally normal. For most of this whole period, even when some days were a little lighter, I’ve been weighed down by that empty, guilty feeling more often than not. It's just been there pretty much almost every day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your ability to sleep since this started?

Um, my eating has been pretty all over the place, to be honest. Like, some weeks I barely touch the staff meal at work, I just don't have any appetite for it. But then other nights, I'll come home and just eat whatever's in the kitchen, just trying to feel settled, I guess. As for sleep, um, it's been a little tricky sometimes, but mostly my appetite is what I've noticed changing the most.
Have you been feeling physically tired or lacking in energy most days during this time?

Um, no, not really. I mean, working as a waiter, I'm on my feet a lot, and I still have enough energy to get through my shifts just fine. So I haven't really felt unusually physically tired or drained most days, no.
Do you often feel like you have very low self-esteem or that you are not as good as the people around you?

Yeah, I do feel that way a lot. Actually, that's a big part of why I came in to get help. I just keep feeling like I've completely let my family down, especially by taking on this mortgage. It's like this heavy guilt I can't shake. And then at work, every time I make even a small mistake, it just feels like proof that I'm completely useless... like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me. It's just a really strong feeling of not being good enough.
Have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where your mood was so low that you felt completely unable to function or lost interest in almost all of the activities you usually enjoy?

No, I don't think I've ever had a time like that. I mean, I feel down and guilty a lot, like I said, but I still go to work and do what I need to do. I haven't had a block of a couple weeks where I just couldn't function at all or completely stopped caring about things I like.
